text='''Independent sparse-snapshot divergence audit
Author: Codex-external_model
UTC: 2026-10-17T00:38Z

Implemented a new output-only auditor at solver/audit_sparse_divergence.py.
Original solver/divergence_audit.py and production physics are unchanged.
No forward simulation, GPU use, or new dependency was required.

API (run from mhd_llm/codex):
  python solver/audit_sparse_divergence.py \\
    results/CHOSEN_PRIMARY/diagnostic_volumes \\
    --output solver/diagnostics/CHOSEN_PRIMARY_sparse_divergence.json

The final primary is deliberately unspecified; no primary scientific result is
inferred from the fixtures below. Parent can run this command after choosing it.
Default analyzes all manifest rows. --snapshot FILE can be repeated to select
rows. --config PATH and --probes PATH are explicit provenance-recorded overrides.
--temporary-directory PATH chooses temporary storage; intermediate metric files
are automatically removed. --memory-mib defaults1536, accepts128..2048;
--slab-radial defaults8. All numerical thread environment variables are set1
before importing NumPy; actual process thread count is recorded.

Input contract coordinated directly with Codex-observations:
  diagnostic_volumes/snapshots.csv: day,file (actual accepted state epochs).
  requested_vs_actual.csv: requested_day,actual_day,file; 17digit actual_day
    refines the rounded manifest day only after strict agreement validation.
  snapshot_#####.npy: [nr,ntheta,nphi,8], C order;
    [n_cm3,vr_kms,vtheta_kms,vphi_kms,p_npa,Br_nt,Btheta_nt,Bphi_nt].
  r_au.npy,theta_rad.npy,phi_rad.npy; metadata.json.
  run.cfg: complete actual configuration copied by sparse helper.
  parent.json: parent_probe_file='../probe.csv',
    parent_metadata_file='../metadata.json', configuration_snapshot='run.cfg';
    parent_output_directory='..', parent_run_config_file='../run.cfg',
    comet_probe_id=0 are also preserved in the receipt.

Geometry uses comet probe ID0 from the parent output, interpolating r, latitude,
and unwrapped longitude at each ACTUAL state time. It rejects extrapolation;
a 5e-10day tolerance only handles decimal serialization, never a cadence gap.
The default coordinate basis/derivative centers are reconstructed in float64
from exact configuration and checked against saved float32 axes. Logarithmic
radial grids use geometric centers, matching the frozen solver. Face geometry
uses exact integrated spherical surface vectors. --center-coordinates stored
reproduces the original auditor's axis-rounding convention for regression.

Methods and norms:
1. Cartesian centered-face FV diagnostic: transform native Br/Btheta/Bphi at
   centers to Cartesian, average adjacent center vectors at each face, dot with
   exact integrated face area, and divide net outward flux by exact volume.
2. Independent centered spherical derivative of r^2 Br and sin(theta)Btheta,
   plus a periodic centered longitude derivative. Nonuniform radial/latitude
   three-point coefficients are used.
One radial and polar cell are excluded; longitude is periodic throughout.
Near-comet output includes the nearest cell and a 3x3x3 neighborhood, clipped to
that interior at radial/polar limits. Thus an ntheta4 wedge yields18, not27,
neighborhood cells; counts are explicit.
For each method, broad regions are all interior, r>.3 AU with |lat|<15deg,
and 1.5<r<2.1 AU with |lat|<15deg. Reported statistics include
  sum(h abs(divB) volume)/sum(|B| volume), h=volume^(1/3),
  exact unweighted median/p95/min/max of local h abs(divB)/|B|,
  volume-mean abs(divB) [nT/AU], volume-mean |B| and h,
  median/p95/min/max of |B| abs(divB)/mu0 / (rho |v|^2/r).
The latter uses total native-frame flow speed and proton mass density. AU
cancels; magnetic conversion is1e-18 for two factors in nT. It is a reference
force/inertia scale, not a measured force, actual advective acceleration, or
an upper bound on solution error. Exact B nulls have zero monopole-force
magnitude but undefined local normalized divergence. Local epsilon excludes
|B|<=1e-12nT by default, without denominator regularization; excluded counts
and volume fractions are reported. Invalid/nonpositive rho|v|^2 are excluded
from force statistics with explicit counts. The integrated B-weighted norm
retains finite magnetic-null cells.

No centered-field diagnostic is a staggered constrained-transport divergence,
Riemann/reconstructed face-field divergence, or GLM cleaning-equation residual.
Float32 snapshots and cancellation limit tiny reported divergences. Near a
current sheet, normalized epsilon can be large because |B| is small; the
force scale and raw dimensional mean are needed alongside it. A decrease in
h|divB|/|B| alone is insufficient to demonstrate dimensional divB convergence
because h itself decreases during refinement. Sparse epochs are diagnostics
at those actual times, not bounds over the complete PN exposure interval.

Memory and exact statistics:
Input volume is read-only mmap, processed in radial slabs with one-cell halos.
A conservative working-array estimate adapts slab size to the requested RSS
budget. Mapped input pages are advised away after each slab on Linux. VmHWM
is checked against the declared limit; getrusage is also recorded because
some launchers retain a larger pre-exec high-water accounting value. Exact
percentiles use disk-backed regional metric files and bounded histogram rank
selection, then exact order statistics within the selected bins; the results
are not histogram-approximate. Temporary disk demand can be several GB for
large production volumes, while resident arrays remain bounded. Full SHA256
of each snapshot is streamed after analysis; the receipt also hashes axes,
manifest, config, probes, metadata, parent pointer, time mapping, and script.

Analytic temporary fixtures (reproducible via retained test script) and real
persisting fixture receipts live in the same directory. Run:

All checks passed:
